title: The Most Underrated Way to Make $2,000 in 48 Hours

stated_problem.quote: I need to make back some of my money from all these pallets, and I thought, why not hold a garage sale?
stated_problem.speaker: Spencer Haws

idea.name: Liquidation return-pallet reselling via garage sale
idea.one_liner: Buy Amazon/retail return pallets and liquidate items through a weekend garage sale plus Facebook Marketplace, eBay and Whatnot
idea.revenue_model: per-item resale margin over pallet cost

key_quotes.quote: I just been listening a bunch of things on Facebook marketplace.
But I listed another dozen things and said, hey, come to the garage sale.

claims.claim: Over $2,000 of product at the sale
claims.quote: I've got way over $2,000 worth of products here.
But I'm happy to say that in day one, the official total was $1,126.
So overall, the garage sale may be in those two days a grand total of $2,210.

claims.claim: Pallet items alone sold $1,725 after $485 of personal items
claims.quote: So technically the total amount that I sold from those palettes $1,725.
And late at night, I negotiated and we settled on a price of $400.
Well, over $3,000 to $4,000 worth of stuff.

acquisition_channels.details: Facebook Marketplace listings driving buyers to the sale

ideas.delivery: seller prices, displays and hands over goods in person over two days
ideas.other_uk_rules: Consumer Rights Act/General Product Safety Regulations when reselling returned electricals; selling expired toiletries is risky
